area: Photo delete/report and salon-side review controls (Solen web)
summary: The salon gallery does NOT live in `salon_photos`. That table is dead (0 rows, `salon_id INTEGER` with no FK against UUID `salons.id`, zero code references outside docs/inventory). The live gallery is `salons.gallery_urls` (text[]) plus a newer categorized mirror table `salon_portfolio_images`, both written by one route: `app/api/salons/[slug]/gallery/route.ts`. A salon owner CAN already delete their own photo today (working end to end: button -> route -> storage -> both tables). An admin CANNOT delete any salon photo: the DELETE handler requires `salon.owner_id === user.id` with no admin branch, and nothing under `app/api/admin/**` touches gallery_urls, salon_portfolio_images, or the salon-gallery bucket. Reviews DO support photos (`review_photos` table is live and rendered on the dedicated reviews page), but the upload is a confirmed silent no-op: the `review-photos` bucket has no INSERT policy, the route uploads with the session client, swallows the error with `continue`, and returns 200 `{success:true, photos:[]}`. `/dashboard/review-moderation` is admin-only (middleware-gated), acts on reviews only, and never touches photos. A report button exists and works, but only for `salon` and `review` targets, there is no `photo` target type. There is NO per-salon reviews toggle anywhere: zero grep hits, no column on `salons`, only a global `feature_flags` key.

findings.claim: RLS: salon_portfolio_images is owner-write / public-read with NO admin policy. review_photos is author-write / public-read with NO admin or salon policy. reviews has NO admin UPDATE policy. Every moderation write in the app therefore depends on the service-role client.
findings.evidence: supabase/migrations/20260725120000_salon_portfolio_images.sql:51-65 (select public true; `for all` owner EXISTS on salons.owner_id). supabase/migrations/051_review_photos.sql:15-33 (select public; insert own; delete own). reviews live policy set per _backend-system/audit/authz.md:29 = one UPDATE policy only, `reviews_update_own_48h` (supabase/migrations/029_review_policies.sql:4), plus 014_new_schema.sql:395-399 select/insert and 029:10,14 delete own/admin, insert tightened by 20260709183909_audit_fix_reviews_insert_requires_booking.sql. Admin writes bypass all of this: createAdminSupabaseClient at app/api/admin/reviews/[id]/route.ts:51,93 and the service-role client at app/api/salons/[slug]/gallery/route.ts:11-14.

findings.claim: Latent RLS hole worth naming while in this file: reviews_update_own_48h has a USING clause and no WITH CHECK, so Postgres reuses USING as the check. Within 48h the review author can PostgREST-update any column on their own row, including is_hidden, moderation_status, salon_response and admin_response.
findings.evidence: supabase/migrations/029_review_policies.sql:4-8 (`FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id AND created_at > now() - interval '48 hours')`, no WITH CHECK, no column grant restriction). _backend-system/audit/authz.md:29 confirms this is the ONE live UPDATE policy on reviews. I read the policy text; I did not test the exploit against the live DB.

Either add a storage.objects INSERT policy for bucket review-photos scoped to `(storage.foldername(name))[1] = reviews.id AND reviews.user_id = auth.uid()`, matching the salon_owners_upload_* pattern used by 5 other buckets, or swap to createAdminSupabaseClient like app/api/clients/[id]/photos and formula-photo already do. gaps.why_it_matters: Admin removal deletes the storage bytes and both DB rows with no audit trail and no reversal, unlike reviews which have is_hidden + moderation_status + removal_reason. A wrongly-removed photo is unrecoverable, and there is no way to show the salon why their photo went away.

Then the reads at app/[locale]/_components/salon/SalonImageGallery.tsx:96 and GalleryManager.tsx:54 filter on it. Note gallery_urls (text[]) cannot carry per-photo state at all, so a hidden photo must ALSO be pulled from gallery_urls or it keeps rendering on the hero, search cards, and profile.

recommendation: Build on `salon_portfolio_images` + `salons.gallery_urls`, never `salon_photos`. Order matters, and step 0 is non-negotiable: verify `salon_portfolio_images` actually exists live (the inventory snapshot predates its migration and its TS type was hand-written) and refresh `_inventory/_db-columns.json` + `_db-snapshot.json`, otherwise every later step builds on an unproven table. (1) Fix the review-photo upload no-op in `app/api/reviews/[id]/photos/route.ts:76-78,100` first, either a storage INSERT policy for the `review-photos` bucket or a swap to `createAdminSupabaseClient()`, because the "photos on reviews" toggle is unverifiable until an upload has ever succeeded. (2) Admin photo delete: add an admin branch to the owner check at `app/api/salons/[slug]/gallery/route.ts:237` (copy the shape from `app/api/salons/[slug]/route.ts:61-64`), keep the existing storage-path guard at `:264-266`, and add `logAuditEvent`. Prefer adding `is_hidden`/`moderation_status`/`removal_reason` to `salon_portfolio_images` so removal is reversible, but note the photo must ALSO be pulled from `salons.gallery_urls` in the same transaction or it keeps rendering on the hero, search cards and profile, that dual source is the single biggest trap in this area. (3) Photo reports: one additive migration widening `content_reports.target_type` to include `'photo'` (same shape as `20260727130000_content_reports_harassment_reason.sql`), then `lib/content-reports.ts`, `lib/validations.ts:834-839`, `components-legacy/discovery/ReportButton.tsx:71-75` plus a photo variant mounted in `app/[locale]/_components/salon/SalonImageGallery.tsx` and `SalonPortfolio.tsx` (report the row id, not the URL), then generalize the `hide_content` branch at `app/api/admin/reports/[id]/route.ts:73-85` past review-only and surface it in `app/[locale]/dashboard/reports/page.tsx:220,280-282`. (4) Per-salon toggles: two boolean columns on `salons` defaulting true, and they MUST be added to the allowlist array at `app/api/salons/[slug]/route.ts:72-91` or the settings save returns 200 and drops them silently, which is this repo's signature failure. UI in `app/[locale]/dashboard/settings/page.tsx` (saves via `:1457`), read gates in `lib/salon-detail.ts:102-107`, `app/api/reviews/salon/[salon_id]/route.ts:41-51`, `app/[locale]/salon/[slug]/reviews/page.tsx:87-96`, write gate next to the existing `checkFeatureEnabled` at `app/api/reviews/route.ts:13`. Two decisions to surface to the owner before building: does disabling reviews HIDE the existing 260 reviews or only block new ones (they are currently public via three separate read paths), and does "anyone can report" mean any signed-in user (what `ReportButton.tsx:118-125` does today by bouncing to login) or genuinely logged-out, which `content_reports.reporter_id` and its `auth.role() = 'authenticated'` insert policy (`078_content_reports.sql:18-19`) do not currently allow. Separately, flag the latent RLS issue at `supabase/migrations/029_review_policies.sql:4-8`: `reviews_update_own_48h` has no `WITH CHECK`, so a review author can self-write `is_hidden`/`moderation_status` via PostgREST for 48 hours, which would undercut any moderation UI built above it.
